blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Creamline’s confidence was tested by a rare three-game skid in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series that put its semifinal hopes in limbo. “I just want to share what Coach told us this week. We acknowledged that we knew the team’s confidence was low, and we needed to lift ourselves. We weren’t denying that our confidence had taken a hit,” said three-time MVP Tots Carlos in Filipino.
